strategy: Transform Pawcasso from $9 one-time purchases to a $1M/year revenue engine by: (1) Launching subscription boxes for recurring revenue, (2) Opening B2B wholesale channel targeting 500+ pet businesses, (3) Scaling TikTok to 100K followers via automation for organic traffic, (4) Building email nurture sequences to drive 30% repeat purchase rate. Target AOV: $35+, conversion rate: 10%, monthly traffic: 30K.

projects.title: Subscription Revenue Engine
projects.description: Launch 'Portrait of the Month Club' subscription ($29/mo, $79/quarter, $249/year) delivering monthly pet portraits in rotating styles. Recurring revenue is the fastest path to $1M. Target 300 subscribers = $104K ARR.

tasks.title: Build Stripe Subscription Checkout with 3 Tier Plans
tasks.description: CREATE website/src/app/subscribe/page.tsx: Landing page explaining subscription benefits (1 portrait/month, priority delivery, exclusive styles, member gallery). Three plans: Monthly ($29/mo), Quarterly ($79 = $26.33/mo, save 10%), Annual ($249 = $20.75/mo, save 30%). Include FAQ accordion, testimonials carousel. MODIFY website/src/app/api/create-subscription/route.ts: Use Stripe Subscriptions API to create recurring payment. Products: STRIPE_PRICE_MONTHLY (price_xxx), STRIPE_PRICE_QUARTERLY, STRIPE_PRICE_ANNUAL. Metadata: {subscription_tier, pet_name, preferred_styles: 'renaissance,watercolor,pop-art'}. Success URL: /subscribe/welcome?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}. CREATE website/src/app/subscribe/welcome/page.tsx: Onboarding flow asking user to upload 3-5 pet photos (store in Vercel Blob under /subscribers/{customer_id}/), select favorite styles (checkboxes), set delivery preferences (email or download portal). CREATE website/src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts handler for invoice.payment_succeeded: On successful monthly charge, queue portrait generation job (store in Vercel Postgres subscribers_queue table with {customer_id, month, status: 'pending', generation_date, delivery_date}). ACCEPTANCE: Three subscription tiers live, checkout works, onboarding captures photos + preferences, webhook queues monthly jobs, subscriber dashboard shows next delivery date.

tasks.title: Automated Monthly Portrait Generation & Delivery Pipeline
tasks.description: CREATE website/scripts/process-subscription-queue.ts: Cron job (runs daily at 3am PT via Vercel Cron) that: (1) Queries subscribers_queue for status='pending' AND generation_date <= TODAY, (2) For each subscriber, fetches random pet photo from their uploads, (3) Selects style based on rotation (Month 1: Renaissance, Month 2: Watercolor, Month 3: Pop Art, cycles), (4) Calls Manus API to generate portrait, (5) Uploads result to Vercel Blob /subscribers/{customer_id}/portraits/{month}-{year}.png, (6) Updates queue status='delivered', (7) Sends email via Resend with download link + social share CTAs. CREATE website/src/app/portal/page.tsx: Subscriber-only portal (auth via Stripe Customer Portal session or magic link). Shows: current plan, next delivery date, portrait gallery (grid of all delivered portraits with download buttons), upload new photos button, manage subscription link (redirects to Stripe billing portal). MODIFY website/src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts: Handle customer.subscription.deleted to mark subscriber as churned, send win-back email with 50% off offer. ACCEPTANCE: Daily cron processes queue, generates portraits, emails subscribers, portal shows delivery history, churn triggers win-back email.

tasks.title: Subscription Acquisition Funnel with Exit Intent Upgrade Offer
tasks.description: MODIFY website/src/components/ExitIntentModal.tsx: Add variant detection - 50% of users see original email capture, 50% see subscription offer. Subscription variant: Headline 'Never run out of portraits - Subscribe & Save 30%', show Annual plan ($249/year = $20.75/mo) with comparison table (One-time: $9, Monthly portraits: $29/mo, Annual plan: $20.75/mo with savings highlighted), CTA 'Start My Subscription'. Track variant in localStorage + analytics. CREATE website/src/app/order/success/page.tsx upsell modal: After one-time purchase, show 'Loved it? Get a new portrait every month' modal with Monthly subscription offer ($29/mo, first month 50% off = $14.50). MODIFY website/src/app/api/create-subscription/route.ts: Accept promo code FIRSTMONTH50 for 50% off first month. CREATE email drip sequence in Resend: Day 0 (purchase): confirmation + referral link, Day 3: 'How's your portrait?' with review request, Day 7: 'Want more?' subscription offer email (50% off first month), Day 14: Last chance subscription offer, Day 30: Re-engagement (25% off one-time purchase). Store sequence progress in subscribers table. ACCEPTANCE: Exit intent shows subscription offer to 50% of users, post-purchase modal converts one-time buyers to subscribers, email drip nurtures to subscription, all promos tracked in Stripe metadata.

projects.title: B2B Wholesale Channel
projects.description: Open wholesale/partnership channel targeting vet clinics, pet groomers, pet stores, animal shelters. Sell in bulk (50-pack licenses for $250 = $5/portrait, 50% margin). One clinic with 500 clients = $2,500 revenue. Target 100 partners in 90 days = $250K revenue.

tasks.title: Build B2B Partner Portal with Bulk License Management
tasks.description: CREATE website/src/app/partners/page.tsx: B2B landing page explaining wholesale program. Target audiences: Veterinary clinics ('Delight clients with memorial portraits'), Pet groomers ('Upsell portraits with grooming packages'), Pet stores ('Gift with purchase promotion'), Animal shelters ('Adoption keepsake portraits'). Pricing: 50-pack ($250 = $5/ea), 100-pack ($450 = $4.50/ea), 500-pack ($2000 = $4/ea). Benefits: White-label option, co-branded templates, priority support, bulk upload portal. CTA: 'Request Partner Access'. CREATE website/src/app/partners/apply/page.tsx: Application form (business name, type dropdown, website, number of customers/month, contact email, how they'll use portraits). Stores in Vercel Postgres partners_applications table. Sends Slack notification to review. CREATE website/src/app/partners/[partnerId]/dashboard/page.tsx: Partner dashboard (auth via magic link or password). Shows: licenses remaining (e.g., '42 of 50 remaining'), bulk upload CSV interface (columns: customer_email, pet_name, pet_photo_url, style_preference), generation queue status table, download all portraits button (ZIP), usage analytics (portraits generated by month). MODIFY website/src/app/api/partners/generate-bulk/route.ts: Accepts CSV upload, validates license count, queues generation jobs in bulk_queue table, decrements license count. ACCEPTANCE: B2B landing page converts inquiries, application stores in DB, partner dashboard manages licenses, bulk CSV upload works, portraits auto-generate and deliver via ZIP download.

tasks.title: Outbound Sales Campaign to 500 Target Businesses
tasks.description: CREATE website/data/b2b-targets.csv: Research and populate 500 rows (business_name, type, website, contact_email, city, estimated_customers_per_month, notes). Use Google Maps API or manual scraping for vet clinics, groomers in top 50 US cities. CREATE website/scripts/b2b-email-generator.ts: Generates personalized cold emails using GPT-4 via OpenAI API. Template: 'Hi [name], I noticed [business_name] has [X] reviews on Google - congrats on building such a loyal client base! We help [vets/groomers] delight customers with AI-generated pet portraits. Imagine offering every client a free digital portrait of their pet after their visit. We provide bulk licenses at $5/portrait (50% off retail). Would you be open to a quick 15min call to explore a partnership? Best, [Your Name]'. Outputs to website/data/b2b-outreach-emails.json. MANUAL STEP: Copy emails to Lemlist, Instantly.ai, or manual Gmail send. CREATE website/src/app/api/partners/track-outreach/route.ts: Track email opens (pixel), link clicks (UTM tracking), responses (webhook from email tool). Stores in partners_outreach_tracking table. CREATE website/src/app/admin/b2b-pipeline/page.tsx: Sales pipeline dashboard showing: Total targets (500), Contacted (count), Opened (rate), Clicked (rate), Responded (count), Applied (conversion), Active partners (revenue). ACCEPTANCE: 500 businesses researched in CSV, emails generated and personalized, outreach tracked in dashboard, pipeline shows conversion funnel.

tasks.title: White-Label Co-Branding System for Enterprise Partners
tasks.description: CREATE website/src/app/api/partners/customize-template/route.ts: API endpoint allowing partners to upload logo (store in Vercel Blob /partners/{partnerId}/logo.png), set brand colors (primary_color, secondary_color hex codes), custom message (e.g., 'Compliments of [Clinic Name]'). Stores in partners_branding table. MODIFY website/scripts/process-subscription-queue.ts AND bulk generation pipeline: Before generating portrait, check if order is from partner. If yes, overlay partner logo in corner (10% opacity), add custom footer text using sharp library. CREATE website/src/components/PartnerBrandingPreview.tsx: Partner dashboard component showing preview of co-branded portrait with their logo/colors. Editable form to update branding. CREATE PDF certificate generator website/scripts/generate-certificate.ts: For each portrait, generate PDF certificate using pdfkit with partner logo, pet name, date, 'This portrait was created by [Partner Name] using Pawcasso AI'. Partner can download certificates to print and give to customers. ACCEPTANCE: Partners upload logo and set colors in dashboard, portraits auto-include partner branding, preview shows accurate rendering, PDF certificates generate with co-branding.

projects.title: TikTok Viral Growth Engine
projects.description: Scale TikTok to 100K followers in 90 days through automated daily posting + engagement tactics. 100K followers = 30K monthly website visitors (30% CTR on link in bio). Already have automation pipeline, need to execute volume + engagement.

tasks.title: 10x Content Production: Generate 90 Days of TikTok Videos in Batch
tasks.description: MODIFY automation/tiktok-video-generator.json n8n workflow: Batch mode that generates 90 videos in one run. For each video: (1) Select random gallery image, (2) Fetch trending audio from TikTok Trending API (use undici or got for HTTP requests), (3) Generate 3 caption variants using GPT-4 (witty, emotional, curiosity-hook), (4) Call Remotion render with template (before/after split screen, ken burns zoom on final portrait, trending text animations). Store output in website/public/tiktok-queue/{day-number}-{animal}-{style}.mp4 with metadata JSON. CREATE website/data/tiktok-posting-calendar.json: 90-day schedule with posting times (best times: 7am, 12pm, 6pm, 9pm PT based on TikTok analytics), assigned video, caption, hashtags (#petportrait #aiart #dogsoftiktok), audio track. CREATE website/scripts/tiktok-auto-post.ts: Reads calendar, uploads video via TikTok Content Posting API at scheduled time (use node-cron for scheduling or Vercel Cron). Logs post_id, view count (fetch 24hrs later via TikTok Analytics API). ACCEPTANCE: 90 unique videos pre-generated, calendar populated with staggered posting times, auto-posting works via API, analytics tracked in JSON.

tasks.title: Engagement Automation: Auto-Reply Comments + DM Follow-Up Sequence
tasks.description: CREATE website/scripts/tiktok-engagement-bot.ts: Runs every 30 minutes via Vercel Cron. Fetches new comments on recent posts via TikTok Comments API. Auto-replies to comments containing keywords: 'how' → 'Link in bio! $9 for your own pet portrait', 'price' → '$9! Check bio for details', 'link' → 'In my bio! Can't wait to see yours', 'cute' → 'Thank you! Want one of your pet? Link in bio'. Uses GPT-4 to generate natural variations to avoid spam detection. Logs engagement in tiktok_comments table. CREATE DM sequence for new followers: When user follows (detect via TikTok webhook or daily follower list diff), send automated DM: 'Hey! Thanks for the follow! Want a free sample portrait? Send me a pic of your pet and I'll create one for you (no strings attached)'. If they reply with photo, queue portrait generation, deliver via DM with CTA 'Love it? Order 3 more styles for $9'. Track DM conversations in tiktok_dm_leads table. ACCEPTANCE: Comments auto-replied with relevant CTAs, new followers receive DM within 24hrs, sample portraits delivered via DM, leads tracked in database.

tasks.title: Influencer Collaboration: Seed 50 Micro-Influencers with Free Portraits
tasks.description: CREATE website/data/tiktok-influencer-targets.csv: 50 pet influencers with 10K-100K followers (use TikTok Creator Marketplace or HypeAuditor). Columns: username, followers, engagement_rate, niche (dog/cat/exotic), email, outreach_status. CREATE website/scripts/influencer-outreach-dm.ts: Generates personalized DMs: 'Hey [name]! Obsessed with [pet_name]'s content! We're an AI pet portrait service and would love to create 3 free portraits of [pet_name] for you (all styles). If you love them, maybe you could share with your followers? No pressure! Let me know if you're interested'. MANUAL STEP: Copy DMs to TikTok inbox. CREATE tracking system: When influencer accepts, generate 3 portraits (Renaissance, Watercolor, Pop Art), deliver via DM with caption templates they can copy-paste, provide unique promo code (INFLUENCER_USERNAME for 20% off, unlimited uses). Track their post in influencer_posts table (post_url, views, likes, clicks from promo code). ACCEPTANCE: 50 influencers researched, DMs drafted and sent, portraits delivered to interested influencers, promo codes tracked, ROI calculated (views generated vs cost of free portraits).

projects.title: Email Marketing & Retention Monetization
projects.description: Build email list to 10K subscribers in 90 days, drive 30% repeat purchase rate via nurture sequences. Email is highest ROI channel (38:1 average). Current list: ~0. Target: 10K emails = 3K buyers at 30% conversion = $90K revenue.

tasks.title: Lead Magnet Funnel: Free Portrait Style Quiz with Email Capture
tasks.description: CREATE website/src/app/quiz/page.tsx: Interactive quiz 'What Art Style Matches Your Pet's Personality?'. 10 questions with image choices (e.g., 'Your pet's energy level?' [Chill couch potato / Playful goofball / Elegant and refined], 'Favorite activity?' [Fetch / Napping / Exploring]). Each answer maps to style scores (Renaissance +2, Watercolor +1, etc.). Results page shows: 'Your pet is a [Style] soul!' with explanation, example portrait in that style, email capture form 'Get your free custom portrait recommendation + 15% off coupon'. Email sent via Resend contains: personalized style recommendation, 3 example images, discount code QUIZ15, CTA to order. Store quiz responses in quiz_leads table (email, answers_json, recommended_style, converted_to_purchase boolean). Add quiz CTA to homepage hero, Instagram bio link, TikTok bio. ACCEPTANCE: Quiz is fun and shareable, email capture works, Resend delivers recommendation email with discount, quiz-to-purchase conversion tracked.

tasks.title: 5-Email Welcome Series with Educational Content & Urgency Tactics
tasks.description: CREATE email sequence in Resend (use Resend Audiences + Broadcasts or code custom drip in website/src/lib/email-sequences/welcome.ts): EMAIL 1 (Day 0, immediate): 'Welcome! Your 15% coupon inside' - Confirms subscription, delivers WELCOME15 code, shows 3 portrait examples, CTA 'Create Your Portrait'. EMAIL 2 (Day 2): 'See how it works' - Embedded demo video (YouTube), customer testimonial, before/after slider, CTA. EMAIL 3 (Day 4): 'Limited time: Upgrade to Premium for $5 more' - Explain Premium benefits (HD, 2 revisions, 12hr delivery), show side-by-side quality comparison, urgency timer (expires in 48hrs). EMAIL 4 (Day 7): Social proof blast - '2,847 portraits created this month', customer photo gallery, Instagram embed of #pawcassoatelier posts, CTA. EMAIL 5 (Day 10): Last chance email - 'Your 15% coupon expires tonight', urgency countdown timer, risk reversal ('100% money-back guarantee'), CTA 'Claim Your Discount'. Track email performance in email_campaigns table (campaign_id, sent, opened, clicked, purchased, revenue). ACCEPTANCE: All 5 emails designed and scheduled, Resend triggers send on correct delays, open/click rates tracked, email-to-purchase attribution works.

tasks.title: Post-Purchase Winback & Referral Loop for 30% Repeat Rate
tasks.description: MODIFY website/src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts: On checkout.session.completed, add customer to Resend audience 'Customers'. Trigger post-purchase sequence: EMAIL 1 (Day 1): 'Your portrait is ready!' - Delivery confirmation, download link, ask to share on social with #pawcassoatelier, CTA 'Share for a chance to be featured'. EMAIL 2 (Day 3): 'How's your portrait?' - Review request (link to Trustpilot or Google Review), 5-star rating component, if 5 stars → ask for testimonial + offer 25% off next purchase. EMAIL 3 (Day 7): 'Refer a friend, get $5' - Explain referral program (friend gets 20% off, you get $5 credit), personalized referral link, social share buttons (WhatsApp, Facebook, Email). EMAIL 4 (Day 14): Cross-sell email - 'Turn [Pet Name] into a coffee mug!' - Introduce print-on-demand products (Printful integration: mugs, t-shirts, canvas prints), show mockups, CTA to shop. EMAIL 5 (Day 30): Winback email - 'Miss [Pet Name]? Get another portrait' - Show their original portrait, suggest new style, offer 20% off, urgency (expires in 3 days). Track repeat purchase rate in customers table (first_purchase_date, second_purchase_date, repeat_customer boolean, referrals_sent, referral_revenue). ACCEPTANCE: 5-email sequence triggers post-purchase, review requests collect testimonials, referral links track conversions, repeat purchase rate hits 30% within 60 days of implementation.
